title: Do Not Pass Judgment on One Another

questions.question: As for the one who is weak in faith, welcome him, but not to quarrel over ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:1 (ESV): "As for the one who is weak in faith, welcome him, but not to quarrel over opinions."

questions.question: One person believes he may eat anything, while the weak person eats only ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:2 (ESV): "One person believes he may eat anything, while the weak person eats only vegetables."

questions.question: Let not the one who eats despise the one who abstains, and let not the one who abstains pass judgment on the one who eats, for God has ____ him.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:3 (ESV): "Let not the one who eats despise the one who abstains, and let not the one who abstains pass judgment on the one who eats, for God has welcomed him."

questions.question: Who are you to pass judgment on the servant of another? It is before his own ____ that he stands or falls.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:4 (ESV): "Who are you to pass judgment on the servant of another? It is before his own master that he stands or falls. And he will be upheld, for the Lord is able to make him stand."

questions.question: One person esteems one day as better than another, while another esteems all days alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:5 (ESV): "One person esteems one day as better than another, while another esteems all days alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind."

questions.question: For none of us lives to himself, and none of us dies to himself. For if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So then, whether we live or whether we die, we are ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:7-8 (ESV): "For none of us lives to himself, and none of us dies to himself. For if we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord. So then, whether we live or whether we die, we are the Lord's."

questions.question: For to this end Christ died and lived again, that he might be Lord both of the ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:9 (ESV): "For to this end Christ died and lived again, that he might be Lord both of the dead and of the living."

questions.question: We will all stand before the judgment seat of God. As it is written: "As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall ____."
questions.explanation: Romans 14:11 (ESV): "For it is written, 'As I live, says the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.'"

questions.question: Therefore let us not pass judgment on one another any longer, but rather decide never to put a ____ in the way of a brother.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:13 (ESV): "Therefore let us not pass judgment on one another any longer, but rather decide never to put a stumbling block or hindrance in the way of a brother."

questions.question: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself, but it is unclean for anyone who ____ it unclean.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:14 (ESV): "I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean in itself, but it is unclean for anyone who thinks it unclean."

questions.question: For if your brother is grieved by what you eat, you are no longer walking in ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:15 (ESV): "For if your brother is grieved by what you eat, you are no longer walking in love. By what you eat, do not destroy the one for whom Christ died."

questions.question: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of ____.
options: righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit
questions.correctAnswer: righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit
questions.explanation: Romans 14:17 (ESV): "For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit."

questions.question: So then let us pursue what makes for ____ and for mutual upbuilding.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:19 (ESV): "So then let us pursue what makes for peace and for mutual upbuilding."

questions.question: It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that causes your brother to ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:21 (ESV): "It is good not to eat meat or drink wine or do anything that causes your brother to stumble."

questions.question: But whoever has doubts is condemned if he eats, because the eating is not from faith. For whatever does not proceed from faith is ____.
questions.explanation: Romans 14:23 (ESV): "But whoever has doubts is condemned if he eats, because the eating is not from faith. For whatever does not proceed from faith is sin."

key_verse_text: For the kingdom of God is not a matter of eating and drinking but of righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
